newsitem.title: USA: Onyx Acceptance stake raised by Bass group.
newsitem.headline: Onyx Acceptance stake raised by Bass group.

text.p: A group that includes members of the Bass family of Forth Worth, Texas, said Thursday it has increased its stake in Onyx Acceptance Corp to 8.4 percent or 481,000 shares from six percent or 384,000 shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group which includes investors Sid and Lee Bass, said it bought the additional shares between May 19 and May 21 at $7.50 to $7.79 each.
